channel.title: Federal News Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Federal News Network (federalnewsnetwork.com)

item.title: FEMA could still support winter storm response in a shutdown, despite administration warnings
item.description: FEMA would have $7-to-$8 billion in its Disaster Relief Fund, which should be enough to limit impacts on winter storm response, at least in the short term.

item.title: ICE, CBP, USCIS leaders to testify before House Homeland Security Committee
item.description: Homeland Security Committee Chairman Andrew Garbarino (R-N.Y.) said transparency and communication are needed to “turn the temperature down.”

item.title: Trump says deal reached on stopgap spending bill for DHS, but weekend shutdown still possible
item.description: The last-minute deal was struck the same day that the Senate failed to advance a spending package that included funding for the Department of Homeland Security.

item.title: Facing mounting energy threats, the Pentagon is betting on industry partnerships to build resilience fast
item.description: "Even as a kid I thought to myself, if the enemy were to attack this area, the first thing that they probably would aim at is that power plant," Tom Holm said.

item.title: Preparing for looming national cyber security threats in 2026 and beyond
item.description: Cyber attacks are becoming focused on targets tied to national security and economic stability.

item.title: The need to re-think government’s digital approach
item.description: Mark Forman, the former administrator for e-government and IT at OMB, explains why it’s time for a mobile-first approach to digital transformation.

item.title: When government stops looking ahead, the risks multiply: new survey shows foresight is fading fast
item.description: "I think this is really an essential next step as we look to continuing the transformation that's going on in the government right now," Cunzeman said.

item.title: The government’s winter of discontent
item.description: A big backlash over ICE shootings in Minneapolis may have provoked a change in policy. Will it maybe make the nation feel less like a place at war with itself?

item.title: Air Force ends hearings for SAP appeals, raising due process questions
item.description: “Folks now have to spend a lot more time thinking about all the things that they're doing that could cost them a security clearance," Dan Meyer said.

item.title: Trump’s pick to lead the NSA vows to follow the law if confirmed
